verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS error-monitoring platform, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented in the vendor's own MindscapeHQ GitHub organization (mcp-server-raygun), which meets the story's core. missing for 10: details of the exposed tools and capabilities, setup and authentication documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
